text:
sqlpipe v2.0 changes the `/v2/users` response.

Breaking change: The `name` field no longer exists. The API now returns `first_name` and `last_name` as separate fields. Update clients that read `name` before you deploy this version. If a user has one stored name part, sqlpipe returns the value in `first_name` and an empty `last_name`.

This release adds the `--incremental` flag. Use `--incremental` to process only rows that changed since the last successful run. The flag reduces repeat work for scheduled jobs and large imports.

Parquet writes are 40% faster in this release. Jobs that export many Parquet files finish sooner and use less CPU time.
